Original 4K material names used by this project:
- Stylized_Grass_001
- Stylized_Grass_002
- Stylized_Grass_003
- Stylized_Ground_002
- Stylized_Dry_Mud_001
- Stylized_Rocks_001
- Stylized_Rocks_003
- Stylized_Ice_001

The runtime copies are resized to 2048x2048 for a practical balance between
close-up terrain detail, mip quality, download size, and GPU texture memory.
